// Acceptance for task (d): the signature, and a Host that passes a facet of a wider store.
import type { ModuleContext } from "@get-modular/resources";
import { createStore, type ListenerError } from "@get-modular/observation";
import { createGreeterModule } from "./d-greeter.js";
import type { GreeterDeps, GreeterProduct } from "./d-greeter.types.js";

const signature: (deps: GreeterDeps, context: ModuleContext) => Promise<GreeterProduct> = createGreeterModule;
type HostSettings = { readonly locale: string; readonly theme: string };
declare const context: ModuleContext;
declare const reportError: (report: ListenerError) => undefined;
const host = createStore<HostSettings>({ locale: "en", theme: "light" }, { name: "settings", resources: context.resources, reportError });
void signature({ settings: host.readonly() }, context);
